title: Regulated industries
description: Extends ISO SRS baseline with safety, risk, V&V, and audit traceability gates for FDA, IEC 62304, DO-178C, and similar domains.

addGlobalCriteria.question: What is the safety / software class (e.g. IEC 62304 Class, DO-178C DAL, SIL level)? List applicable regulations.
addGlobalCriteria.graphProbe: NFR nodes tagged safety, regulatory, classification

addGlobalCriteria.question: Required verification rigor per requirement type (unit, integration, system, independent review)?
Confirm bidirectional traceability: requirement ↔ risk/hazard ↔ test case. Which link types exist in your process?
addGlobalCriteria.graphProbe: satisfies, verifies, mitigates edges between requirement and risk nodes

addGlobalCriteria.question: Every safety- or security-related FR must have measurable acceptance criteria — confirm or list exceptions.
Configuration management: who approves requirement baseline changes? Impact analysis required before edits?
addGlobalCriteria.graphProbe: release, baseline, changeControl metadata on system node

addGlobalCriteria.question: List authoritative inputs (risk analysis, hazard log, intended use, clinical evaluation, SOUP list) with paths.
Cybersecurity and privacy controls required (threat model, encryption, access control, audit logging)?
addGlobalCriteria.graphProbe: NFR nodes tagged security, privacy, cybersecurity

addGlobalCriteria.question: Independence requirements for verification activities (who must NOT be the author)?
